pkm_semaev.rs @ b847203692. digit_sums(p, lo, digits): 2^t entries, entry k = lo%p + sum over set bits j of k of (c_j % p), each step addm mod p (u64, p<2^20, no overflow); for c_j=2^j entry k = lo+k (unit test digits_two_powers_reproduce_bits plus my binary replays). digits_factor_base -> abscissa_factor_base: sort+dedup abscissae, keep those with rhs(x) a QR (curve.sqrt), both signs; the base is ALL curve points over those abscissae (cofactor cosets included, NOT intersected with the order-r subgroup: base_points = 2*columns, covered_points_all_cosets > covered_points). prepare() for Digits: checks digits.len()==t, rejects a repeated subset sum, and rejects any base abscissa outside the sum set; the t=5 and t=6 sets have 32 and 64 distinct sums (my check). System build: coef(j)=digits[j]%p replaces 2^j for the linear form x_i = base + sum_j coef(j) b_(i,j); rules b^2=b are pushed for Bits and Digits alike (same SquareRule{c:1,d:0}); guessing fixes the top g digits c_(t-g..t-1) of summand 0 with bit k of the branch index <-> b_(t-g+k), offset summed with addm - identical to `a << (t-g)` when c_j=2^j; free bits j in 0..t-g. grid/v set = digit_sums. Decode: solutions are abscissae looked up in fb.x_index then lifted with signs (lift_abscissae), no 2^j assumption remains (grep of 1u64<<, lo+k sites: all in Bits/T0/Kummer/Square arms). No off-by-one or modular defect found. Note: charged F4 unit is 'elimination only'; system build (pkm_system_fp_mults_uncharged) and the grid (pkm_grid_fp_mults_uncharged) are uncharged (see E5).
